headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.jointSourceMatrixCode_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (a : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.jointSourceMatrixCode (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U
      (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑a.fst)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.jointResidualMatrixCode r c U L hr hc a) =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalSourceMatrixCode r c U L a

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.jointSourceMatrixCode_draw
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (d : Math115.PhysicalDefectTrace.DefectVertices r c U L) (h : ℕ)
  (word : Fin (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc (↑d) h) → Bool),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.jointSourceMatrixCode (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U
      (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑d)
      (Math115.LatticeSampler.draw
        (((List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows r c U L hr ↑d),
              List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseColumns r c U L hc ↑d)),
            h),
          List.ofFn word)) =
    Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalSourceMatrixCode r c U L
      ⟨d, Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.completionDraw r c U L hr hc (↑d) h word⟩

headlines.name: Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.jointTerminalCorrectionCode_eq
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (a : Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.DefectJoint r c U L) (k : ℕ) (word : Fin k → Bool),
  Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.jointTerminalCorrectionCode (List.ofFn r) (List.ofFn c) U L k
      (Math115.PhysicalComputedProposal.computedStateCode r c U L ↑a.fst)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.jointResidualMatrixCode r c U L hr hc a)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalOrderedLabelCode r c U L a).1
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalOrderedLabelCode r c U L a).2 (List.ofFn word) =
    Option.map (fun X => OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode ↑X)
      (Math115.PhysicalTraceJoin.terminalBitCorrection r c U L k a word)
